parsed.why: Lowest-risk tier, explicit public-accommodations protection with enforced remedies, open markers, city care shield for travellers; but national passport, entry-screening, custody and facility regime still applies unchanged.

Do-Not-Travel tier: birth-sex facility ban across public buildings including airports, criminal penalties plus private bounty suits, and driver's-licence invalidation — tier-1 universal exposure with only a pending, unremedied challenge.

Worst-policies tier: school/public facility ban, criminal misdemeanour provision, no state protections or hate-crime cover, religious healthcare denial reaching emergency care; somewhat narrower than the bounty/licence regime elsewhere.

Most-protective tier: statewide accommodations and hate-crime cover, mandated gender-neutral facilities, shield law protecting visitors from ban jurisdictions, panic defence repealed — offsetting but not escaping hostile national entry and custody rules.

Statewide birth-sex facility exclusion, no state discrimination or hate-crime protection, religious refusals of goods and services, court barring birth-certificate change, custody-solitary prospect; hostile layer without the bounty/licence escalation.
